result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would make technology and knowledge equally accessible to everyone—bridging gaps so that every person, no matter where they live or their circumstances, has the tools to learn, create, and improve their lives.  

I think of it as turning on a light in every corner, so that no one is left in the dark simply because of where they were born. One spark can ignite countless possibilities.  

What about you—if you had that one chance, what would you change?
